name: cost-optimization-hub
description: You can use the Cost Optimization Hub API to programmatically identify, filter, aggregate, and quantify savings for your cost optimization recommendations across multiple Amazon Web Services Regions and Amazon Web Services accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: get-preferences
subcommands.description: Returns a set of preferences for an account in order to add account-specific preferences into the service.

subcommands.name: get-recommendation
subcommands.description: Returns both the current and recommended resource configuration and the estimated cost impact for a recommendation.

subcommands.name: list-efficiency-metrics
subcommands.description: Returns cost efficiency metrics aggregated over time and optionally grouped by a specified dimension.

subcommands.name: list-enrollment-statuses
subcommands.description: Retrieves the enrollment status for an account.

subcommands.name: list-recommendation-summaries
subcommands.description: Returns a concise representation of savings estimates for resources.

subcommands.name: update-enrollment-status
subcommands.description: Updates the enrollment (opt in and opt out) status of an account to the Cost Optimization Hub service.

subcommands.name: update-preferences
subcommands.description: Updates a set of preferences for an account in order to add account-specific preferences into the service.
